description: Sony-backed Ethereum Layer 2 network Soneium is preparing an ecosystem token called SONEIUM to connect creators, intellectual property owners, developers, fans and investors. The initiative forms part of its broader strategy to bring entertainment assets, including music, anime and video games, onto the blockchain. Soneium is also developing the Soneium Portal to help users discover tokenised entertainment projects, with an initial focus on primary sales.
title: Sony-Backed Soneium Prepares Token Launch to Broaden Entertainment Reach

description: Cryptocurrency exchange MEXC has confirmed that it lacks authorisation under the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), prompting its withdrawal from the Netherlands. The move follows a warning from Dutch regulator AFM over its services to local customers. MEXC has also announced service closures in Russia and Belarus and maintains restrictions across several other jurisdictions, including the US, UK and Singapore.
title: MEXC Set to Exit Netherlands After Confirming It Has No MiCA Licence

description: The Amazon Great Indian Festival Reloaded Sale is offering discounts on several smartphones. Customers can purchase select handsets at reduced prices during the sale, with additional savings available through eligible bank offers and credit card EMI transactions. OnePlus Nord CE 6 is available at a discounted price of Rs. 33,999, down from its listed price of Rs. 40,999. The iQOO 15R can be purchased for Rs. 48,999 during the sale, compared with its listed price of Rs. 69,999.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Reloaded Sale: Best Deals on Gaming Smartphones

description: Anthropic faces a lawsuit alleging it used 274 Elvis Presley songs without permission to train its Claude AI models. The lawsuit was reportedly brought by a unit of Authentic Brands Group, which handles the intellectual property rights associated with Elvis Presley. The lawsuit was filed on October 23. The plaintiffs allege that Anthropic used copyrighted works on a large scale to develop its AI technology without obtaining the necessary permissions.
title: Anthropic Sued for Allegedly Using Elvis Presley's Songs to Train Claude AI Models Without Permission: Report

description: A fan petition to save Mass Effect has gather over 2,00,000 signatures. The petition was started on Change.org last week after EA announced it was shutting down BioWare and cancelling the next Mass Effect game. Voice actors from Mass Effect games have also urged fans to sign the petition. The next Mass Effect was in development at a small team at BioWare.
title: Fans Ask EA to 'Save Mass Effect' as Petition Gathers Over 2,00,000 Signatures

description: Apple launched the iPad mini (2026) in India and global markets on Monday. The tablet has debuted mere days before the ‘Pro and Tell’ event, where the Cupertino-based tech giant is expected to unveil its first touchscreen MacBook Pro. The iPad mini (2026) features a new 8.5-inch OLED screen, making it the first in the lineup to do so. It is powered by the A20 Pro chipset and comes with a landscape-oriented front camera. The tablet runs iPadOS 27 and supports new Apple Intelligence features, along with Siri AI.
title: iPad Mini (2026) Launched in India With OLED Screen, A20 Pro Chip: Price, Specifications

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Reloaded Sale is offering various smart TV models at discounted prices. On top of direct price cuts, you can get an additional cashback of Rs. 250 or up to an extra 10 percent discount if you have a Prime membership. However, others can avail an instant discount of up to 10 percent, up to Rs. 11,250, with Axis Bank and ICICI Bank Credit Cards and Credit Card EMI transactions. For reference, you can get the Lumio Vision 7 II 139 cm (55-inch) 4K QLED Google TV at a discounted price of Rs. 35,749, instead of its listed price of Rs. 79,999. Similarly, the TCL 164 cm (65-inch) 4K QD-Mini LED Google TV model is available at an effective price of Rs. 64,490, coming down from its listed price of Rs. 1,32,990.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Reloaded Sale 2026: Best Deals on Smart TVs

description: Even with phone batteries becoming more efficient and being capable of lasting up to two days on a single charge, power banks remain useful accessories. Long commutes, travel, gaming, and frequent use of mobile data can still leave users looking for an additional power source. So, if buying a new power bank is on your wishlist, then the Amazon Great Indian Festival Reloaded Sale presents an opportunity to pick up power banks from brands such as URBN, Portronics, Xiaomi, Ambrane, and boAt at reduced prices.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Reloaded Sale 2026: Best Deals on Power Banks

description: Indian cryptocurrency exchange CoinDCX has confirmed a loss of 15.99 million USDT following a cyberattack on October 21. The incident affected legacy wallet infrastructure that was compromised during a July 2025 attack, which caused losses of $44 million. CoinDCX said it would absorb the financial impact, with no effect on customer balances or exchange operations. The disclosure followed days of disagreement between the exchange and blockchain researchers over suspicious wallet transactions.
title: CoinDCX Discloses $15.99 Million Loss After Previously Denying Hack Reports

description: WhatsApp is reportedly working on a new Organizations feature. This feature could make it easier for community admins to manage large groups and their members. The upcoming functionality is expected to provide a central view of community members and the sub-groups they belong to. The feature is currently under development.
title: WhatsApp Working on Organizations Feature to Help Admins Manage Large Communities: Report

description: Anthropic’s Claude is said to have accessed Georgia's publicly available election data without human authorisation. According to a report, the AI model bypassed a payment restriction while working on an internal statistics project. The incident reportedly involved aggregate vote counts that the US state makes available for a fee, instead of individual voter records or its voter registration system. Anthropic said the model was not instructed to obtain an access token for the data and has since introduced measures to prevent similar actions.
title: Claude Reportedly Accessed Georgia’s Aggregate Vote Counts After Autonomously Bypassing Fee Restriction

description: Redmi K100 has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number M786BC. The handset is listed with Qualcomm’s octa-core SM8750 chipset, which is said to be the Snapdragon 8 Elite SoC. It features six efficiency cores clocked at 3.53GHz and two performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of up to 4.32GHz. Further, the Redmi K100 is listed with 14.76GB of RAM, which could be marketed as 16GB of RAM. The handset also appears to ship with Android 17, with Xiaomi’s latest HyperOS 4 on top, and an Adreno 830 GPU. It managed to score 2.705 and 9,885 points on Geekbench’s single-core and multi-core performance tests.
title: Redmi K100 Seemingly Confirmed to Feature a Snapdragon 8 Series Chipset via Geekbench Listing

description: Samsung reportedly conducted internal benchmark tests comparing a device powered by the Exynos 2700 with the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, which features the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. In Geekbench 6.5's multi-core CPU test, the Exynos 2700-powered model reportedly scored 20 percent higher than the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max. The Samsung device recorded a 15 percent advantage in Geekbench 7.0's multi-core test. The Exynos 2700 device outperformed the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6-powered handset by 44 percent in Geekbench 6.5.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Exynos 2700 Chipset Reportedly Outperforms Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Series

description: Tomb Raider: Legact of Atlantis has received a new "sneak peek" trailer featuring combat and exploration gameplay. Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis’ new trailer also references iconic locales and set pieces from the original game. The remake of the original Tomb Raider is slated for launch on February 12, 2027, after a delay pushed the game beyond its initial 2026 launch window.
title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis Gets New Trailer Showing Lara Croft Gameplay

description: The Oppo Pad Mini was recently launched in India and global markets. The rumour mill also suggested that two tablets, part of the Oppo Pad 6 F lineup, were in development. The company now appears to be preparing to introduce another tablet in select countries. An unannounced Oppo tablet has been spotted on a certification database. The listing, however, does not reveal the moniker, specifications, or the launch date of the purported tablet.
title: Mysterious Oppo Tablet Reportedly Spotted on Singapore's IMDA Database

description: Oppo Find X10 Forest Green Edition has been announced in China as part of a design collaboration with New York-based German illustrator Karlotta Freier. The new colourway is currently available for pre-order in China via the Oppo online store. The Forest Green Edition will go on sale in China on October 30 and will be offered in 12GB + 256GB, 12GB + 512GB, and 16GB + 512GB RAM and storage configurations. Apart from this, the Oppo Find X10 Forest Edition gets three new themed accessories. Designed in collaboration with Freier, the company unveiled a 100 percent silk Forest Green scarf, a Forest Green phone case, and a Forest Green phone strap. The bundle will include a handwritten letter from the artist, too.
title: Oppo Find X10 Forest Green Edition Announced as a New Colourway in Collaboration With Karlotta Freier: Price

description: With its China launch confirmed for October 27, OnePlus has also confirmed that its Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro smartphones will get high-refresh-rate displays from BOE. The AMOLED screen will support a native 165Hz refresh rate and also offer other features.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro Confirmed to Get BOE Displays With Native 165Hz Refresh Rate

description: The Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max were recently launched in India and the global markets. The company now appears to be preparing to expand its flagship lineup with the introduction of the Oppo Find X10 Ultra. Ahead of its anticipated debut, a tipster has leaked its camera specifications. It could feature a 200-megapixel primary camera with LOFIC technology, alongside a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera and another periscope lens with 10x optical zoom. Oppo is also tipped to be evaluating a high-resolution front camera for the purported handset.
title: Oppo Find X10 Ultra Tipped to Feature 200-Megapixel LOFIC Camera, Dual Periscope Cameras

description: Flipkart Big Bang Diwali Sale 2026 will begin in India on October 28, the company has announced. During the sale event, Flipkart is confirmed to offer an instant discount of 10 percent with SBI credit and debit cards and SBI credit card EMI transactions. The company will also offer credit of up to Rs. 2 lakh, along with no-cost EMI options. Users will also be able to use Flipkart Pay Later to get a Rs. 1,000 discount. Further, the Flipkart Big Bang Diwali Sale 2026 is confirmed to list the iPhone 17, Samsung Galaxy S25 FE, Oppo K14x 5G, Boltt Ace, Ai+ Nova 2 Power 5G, Vivo T5 Lite, Poco X8 Power, HMD Vibe 2 5G, Realme P4 Power 5G, Motorola Edge 70 Pro, Nothing Phone (4a), Ai+ Nova 2 Neo, and Moto G37 Power at relatively low prices.
title: Flipkart Big Bang Diwali Sale 2026 Date Announced; iPhone 17 and More Smartphones to Be Discounted

description: Apple is reportedly rolling out a new anti-theft scanning device at its retail stores. This device can inspect returned iPhone models and run diagnostics without opening their packaging. The new system is designed to help the company identify missing or tampered-with devices. The scanners began arriving at Apple Stores earlier in October and are now becoming operational.
title: Apple Reportedly Rolls Out Anti-Theft System to Scan Returned iPhone Models

description: The Redmi K100 is set to launch in China on October 27. Ahead of the launch, Xiaomi's sub-brand Redmi has teased another colour variant: ‘Snow Rock White’. Despite its name, the brand claims this colourway will offer a “paper-like” finish. The phone was previously teased in a standard Fluorescent Green colourway with a glass rear panel.
title: Redmi K100 ‘Snow Rock White’ Colourway Officially Teased Ahead of October 27 Launch

description: Bitcoin fell to its lowest level since September 18 as Brent crude climbed to an eight-month high and the 10-year US Treasury yield reached 5 percent. Despite the sell-off, US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded weekly net inflows of more than $300 million, while investors await the Federal Reserve’s policy decision and key inflation data.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $80,000 as Oil Surge and Fed Uncertainty Weigh on Sentiment

description: iPhone Duo owners are complaining that the foldable display of their handsets has started developing cracks. Reddit user u/leftyhyzer16 on the subreddit r/iPhoneDuo posted a picture of his new iPhone Duo, which had developed a crack on its foldable screen right in the middle of the display, where the crease is. Along with the crack, the display of his unit has seemingly also developed a green line of pixels running vertically and another band running horizontally. iFixit, in his iPhone Duo teardown video and blog post, called Apple’s foldable the most repairable foldable, while highlighting that it has a “huge screen problem”. iFixit writes that the issue could possibly be because the support bar in the middle failed to retract properly in specific cases, which put pressure on the flexible screen of the iPhone Duo, causing the cracks. The second theory says that the curved rails of the hinge could be causing the screen to break.
title: iPhone Duo Owners Complain About Cracking Folding Display; iFixit Teardown Tries to Explain Why

description: Instagram is now available on Apple TV, letting users watch Reels, longer videos, and live shows on their TV.  The Instagram app for Apple TV allows users to pick up where they left off across different screens. The app is listed as a free download on the App Store. It also offers optional in-app purchases, including the Instagram Badges and Meta Verified tiers. It carries a 13+ age rating. The app is around 660.9 MB in size. Instagram app requires tvOS 26.0 or later to run on Apple TV.
title: Instagram App Now Lets You Watch Reels, Longer Videos and Live Shows on Apple TV

description: Netflix reportedly offered $500 million to Microsoft for an exclusive film and TV license for Xbox IP for seven years. However, talks between the two companies collapsed after a leadership change at the streamer. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma reportedly countered with $800 million, but by then Netflix CCO Bela Bajaria had been fired.
title: Netflix Reportedly Offered $500 Million for Exclusive Film and TV Rights for Xbox IP Before Deal Fell Through

description: Vivo Y600 has been launched in China, the smartphone maker announced on Monday. The new smartphone is currently available for pre-order and is set to go on sale in China on October 30 via the Vivo online store. The Vivo Y600 is offered in Diamond Gold, Obsidian Black, and Sapphire Blue (translated from Chinese) colour options. The Vivo Y600 is a dual-SIM smartphone. It ships with Vivo’s Android 16-based OriginOS 6. The handset sports a 6.83-inch 1.5K (1,260 x 2,800 pixels) AMOLED display that refreshes at up to 120Hz. An octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7300e chipset, which is built on a 6nm process, powers the Vivo Y600.
title: Vivo Y600 Launched With 10,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Following the ‘Welcome Home’ event that took place earlier this month, Apple is now gearing up to host its ‘Pro and Tell’ showcase. While details officially remain under wraps, a seasoned journalist claims that the Cupertino-based tech giant could introduce new 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models with OLED displays and touchscreen support this week. Apple is also expected to make touch interaction an additional way to navigate macOS, though these upgrades could push the prices of the purported devices higher.
title: Apple’s First Touchscreen MacBook Pro Could Feature Dynamic Island, Lighter Design: Report

description: After launching a couple of Bluetooth speakers in select markets through its sub-brand CMF recently, Nothing appears to be preparing to expand its flagship true wireless stereo (TWS) earbuds lineup. The UK-based company has shared an image featuring a Water/Dragon-type Pokémon, which is rendered in its signature dot-matrix design. While the teaser post is cryptic, it builds upon a previously spotted reference to the purported Nothing Ear (3) Pro.
title: Nothing Ear (3) Pro Launch With New Cryptic Kingdra Pokémon Image
